newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly softer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly softer in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its American counterpart in quiet pre-weekend trade on Friday, with the rate expected to continue to move narrowly on a lack of market-inspiring news, dealers said.
The rate finished at T$27.492 compared with Thursday's T$27.490 close. Turnover was US$242.5 million.

The foreign exchange market followed stable domestic money markets and some players stepped to the sidelines because of the steady U.S. dollar performance in overseas markets. "I don't expect major movements in the market," said one dealer, seeing a T$27.48-51 range in the near term. - Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
